notes.title: The game has been updated~ the solar system is coming!
notes.content:
The game has been updated~

Add a lot of interesting content!

1. Fuel has been added,if you run out of fuel,it will  be unable to drive the spacecraft.

2. New maps have been added , the solar system.

3. Add the function of small map, press the M key to see the small map.

4. Mining function has been added.

5. Adding scanning function, it can scan some interesting things.

6. The Moon Base has been added. At present, there is a shortage of minerals. It is under construction.

7. Physical systems have been strengthened and games will be more difficult.

8. There are also some information output.


Future outlook

1. The new ship will be launched after the completion of the lunar base and the construction of the dock.

2. Future plans are to open bases on asteroids.

3. We plan to start developing a multiplayer online model.
